text:
nina: Quick note  the nightly usage reconciliation job is reporting missing usage records for a handful of seat-based customers. Totals don't match Stripe ledger.

rachel: Any pattern on which customers? Enterprise only?

nina: Small set, all customers on the legacy monthly seat billing plan. Looks like the nightly job failed to pick up seat delta events emitted by the billing-listener service between 2026-04-11T02:00 and 02:17 UTC.

kevin: Billing-listener had an autoscaler bounce during that window and dropped ~150 messages. We have a tombstone counter but it wasn't surfaced.

nina: Oof. That bubble caused usages to be undercounted and invoices short by a few hundred USD.

billing-bot: incident: billing-listener autoscaler bounced at 2026-04-11T02:05 UTC, dropped_events=152.

rachel: Can we rerun reconciliation for that window only?

kevin: I'll rehydrate the event stream from our message archive and run the reconciliation in dry-run mode. Also adding a guard to pause invoicing if discrepancy > $1000 in a run.

nina: Finance: we'll need an approval to issue supplemental invoices for these customers if the rerun confirms underbilling.

rachel: Approve supplemental invoices for confirmed underbilling < $500 each. For >$500 escalate to finance ops for manual review.

kevin: Reconciliation dry-run: missing usages found for 9 customers. Suggested supplemental invoices total $1,120. Two customers would be >$500.

nina: I'll prepare draft notices and cc legal for the >$500 cases.

billing-bot: reconcile: dry-run complete. missing_amount_total=1120, customers_flagged=2

kevin: After the rerun, we'll also implement a retry log metric that surfaces dropped message counts to the billing dashboard.

rachel: Thanks. Please post the final CSV and include contact owners for CS outreach.

nina: Uploaded supplemental-invoice_candidates.csv to shared drive and assigned owners.

kevin: PR open to gate autoscaler during critical reconciliation window: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing-listener/pull/78

nina: Great. Closing this thread once invoicing notifications are sent.
